snippet.title: Boss fight against Greystone - Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero
snippet.description:
Boss fight against Greystone - Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero

The story starts with Greystone forcing Adam into entering the Hammashan castle from which no one comes back alive. The second level ends with Adam destroying Greystone's statue.
